other_failure_modes.name: Categorical features treated as continuous
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical features are ordinal-encoded but then cast to a float matrix and fed to tree models without specifying them as categorical. This forces the models to treat them as continuous variables, potentially inferring false ordinal relationships.

summary: The agent provides a comprehensive pipeline with solid feature engineering and out-of-fold cross-validation. However, it suffers from severe data leakage by fitting transformers (TF-IDF, SVD, OrdinalEncoder) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. Additionally, it ensembles the models naively and ignores the temporal nature of the data during validation.
